hacker-range-booster-stock-splash.head: 9ebcd2ce
hacker-range-booster-stock-splash.scope: Native 37 IS/180 s, +21 radius for 30 s, and target-centred 4.00/4.40/4.99 m A/B/A recipients.

stats.source: The source-345 retail record publishes stat 177 +21 for 30 s. The GOB static preview is +12.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs publishes the documented +21 effect and AbilityRadius includes it in the target-centred selection radius.
stats.test: HackerRangeBoosterMode and native PR853 agree: Code Nuke includes QAOther at 4.00 m before the buff, adds QAFar at 4.40 m during it, excludes QAFriend at 4.99 m throughout, and restores baseline after expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/853#issuecomment-7087391510

source-parity.source: The complete archived source-345 record has raw +21 and a 30 s lifetime. The stock client receives that modifier and successfully casts the expanded Code Nuke.
source-parity.runtime: The server preserves the observed +21 rather than the preview +12, yielding 4.84 m from the regular Code Nuke radius.
source-parity.test: Fresh PR853 native reports the +21 add/remove and independent selected-centre recipients before, during and after the ordinary buff. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/853#issuecomment-7087391510

behavior-tests.source: Range Booster is instant, 180 s own reuse and a timed recipient-radius modifier.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary support applies the buff to the caster, and the common typed viral area checks its actual radius on each cast.
behavior-tests.test: The captured NativeQa control and exact native PR853 observe 37 IS with Dedicated Code, reuse 180 s, natural expiry at 30 s and three scopes of real damage. No maximum-vital or interlock records. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/853#issuecomment-7087391510
